# Acme DS

> React 18 + TypeScript design system. Components are styled only with design tokens (CSS variables).
> Import components from `@acme/ds` and load `@acme/ds/foundations.css` once at the app root.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): setup, principles, component usage, token rules
- [Usage rules](acme.rules.json): machine-readable guidance and review categories (source of truth)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Acme skill](.claude/skills/acme/SKILL.md): step-by-step workflow for building UI with Acme

## Components

- [Button](src/components/Button/Button.tsx): actions. variant: primary | secondary | destructive | ghost; size: sm | md
- [Alert](src/components/Alert/Alert.tsx): inline status messages. intent: success | warning | danger
- [Input](src/components/Input/Input.tsx): single-line text entry. label (required), error, hint
- [Surface](src/components/Surface/Surface.tsx): content container. tone: default | subtle | tinted; padding: space.4 | space.5 | space.6
- [Stack](src/components/Stack/Stack.tsx): layout spacing. direction: row | column; gap: space.1-space.7; align
- [Chip](src/components/Chip/Chip.tsx): removable or selectable tags and filters. label, onRemove, selected, onToggle
- [Badge](src/components/Badge/Badge.tsx): read-only counts and status labels. label
- [Card](src/components/Card/Card.tsx): deprecated, use Surface

## Tokens

- [Primitive](tokens/primitive.json), [Semantic](tokens/semantic.json), [Component](tokens/component.json): DTCG JSON
- Built output: `dist/tokens.css` (CSS variables), `dist/tokens.ts` (typed map)
